{{Quote|I require Zuckuss alive! You two are another matter.|Boba Fett, as he blasts the Herglic|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 4">[[Shadows of the Empire 4|''Shadows of the Empire'' 4]]</ref>}}
A '''Herglic bounty hunter''' was among a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], and [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] that tried to steal the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. The [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]], along with an unnamed [[Unidentified green-skinned alien bounty hunter|four-armed hunter]], and Zuckuss, boarded Fett's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. After tricking [[Furlag]], who was charged with securing Fett within his own prisoner cells, Fett dropped down from a hatch and dispatched two of his assailants, [[Blaster/Legends|blasting]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] both the Herglic and the [[Alien/Legends|alien]].
